plan.name: v1.9.7-bridge-replay
plan.info: Bridge reliability improvements and fee burn simplification

title: Upgrade: v1.9.7-bridge-replay
summary:
This upgrade improves bridge reliability and simplifies fee handling.

Reliability improvements:
- Orchestrator replays pending outbound burns on startup (prevents stuck burns)
- Late/duplicate attestations now emit bridge_attest events for accurate tracking
- Requires CometBFT tx_index=on for transaction search

Fee simplification:
- Bridge fees now burned immediately in MsgBridgeBurn (no escrow)
- Removes BurnFromModuleExact call on attestation confirmation
- Reduces module account state churn

API changes (breaking):
- REST: /bridge/minted -> /bridge/mint
- CLI: miraged q bridge minted -> miraged q bridge mint
- Proto: QueryBridgeMintedRequest/Response -> QueryBridgeMintRequest/Response

BINARY REQUIREMENT: All validators must update to v1.9.7 binary BEFORE the upgrade height.
CONFIG REQUIREMENT: Ensure config.toml has [tx_index] section with indexer = "kv"
